facts.fact: Le Rônier reports that the 14th ordinary board session of AMANORM, Mali's standards and quality promotion agency, met on 29 January 2026 under the Ministry of Industry and Commerce's secretary-general and adopted a 2026 budget of 243,306,303 FCFA against 318,369,036 FCFA in 2025.

systems.country_label: Agence Malienne de Normalisation et de Promotion de la Qualité
systems.owner: Ministry of Industry and Commerce (supervising ministry)

note: Budget and governance story only: no named IT or data standard and no certification stated; calls on firms to follow national and international standards without naming any.
